name: companion_router_adapter_plan
purpose: Define the future Companion adapter boundary before any Universal Intent Router wiring.

current_routes.future_adapter_role: route Companion conversational input through router observation before existing handler
preserve queued chat behavior while adding router observation later

migration_steps: keep existing Companion and queued chat handlers unchanged
add a Companion shadow adapter in a future stage
run router dry-run beside current Companion handling
compare router intent and model tier against current behavior
only later enable safe adapter routing behind an explicit flag

never mutate calendar or profile state during Stage 6U
never route admin/auth/power/internal/system inputs through Companion adapter
